name: pryzael
description: Rigorous engineering workflows for system understanding, architecture, debugging, review, verification, and auditable handoffs.

interface.longDescription: Reusable engineering workflows for understanding how systems work and why they were designed that way, architecture design, root-cause debugging, blast-radius analysis, adversarial review, verifiable multi-step execution, proof of completion, and auditable handoffs. Canonical Skill workflows are projected as read-only remote MCP tools by the hosted Pryzael Worker.
defaultPrompt: Explain how this subsystem works and where its ownership boundaries are.
Investigate why this design exists and separate evidence from inference.
Architect this change before implementation and identify the invariants.
Review this exact GitHub candidate against its base and report only actionable findings.
Verify whether this work is actually complete and show the evidence.
